notes: The HWI should have the right part of ふ replaced with left of い. As Mincho, ふ's left part connects to い's left; because い is higher, the slant also needs to be higher.

sources.title: 蝦夷方言藻汐草 (Ezo hōgen moshiogusa), vol. 2, p. 30 (canvas 64ウ), line 10
sources.holder: National Institute for Japanese Language and Linguistics
sources.weakness: Given as the model for the joined form. Counted from the right, line 10 of this page reads 福寿草 クナウ▲クマウボー in the site's transcription, and no ふい form was located on it at the scan's resolution; the form it was meant to show is uncertain.
